lessons_used: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning onboarding stages (redesign) and reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect, falling far short of optimistic predictions.
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy) and adding desktop status indicators showed no clear effect.
Predictions for redesigns, step reordering, copy changes, and guidance additions were consistently too high.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Pet Animation Preview
candidates.change: Displays a playful animated pet preview graphic on the waiting screen while background pet generation takes place.
candidates.why: Adoption and generation take a median of 89 seconds and overall home step completion time is long (median 201s). Visual progress cues keep users engaged.

guard.reason: Adds a pet preview animation on the waiting screen without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen info changes have proven strong results (+8.9%), though home step has lower drop-off.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Instant Validation Checklist
candidates.change: Adds an explicit quality checklist below photo upload to guide users on lighting and pose before submitting.
candidates.why: Support logs 3 issues regarding custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly due to bad source photos.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure photos are well-lit and front-facing for optimal 3D pet rendering.

components.text: Clear front-facing view, Good lighting, Single subject

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo quality validation checklist and hint on the upload screen.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with support evidence, but path hints historically show no clear effect or slight negative lift.

candidates.title: Completion Desktop Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Provides an opt-in toggle on the home intro screen to send a desktop notification once the pet is fully ready.
candidates.why: Mean finish time is high (5815s) indicating users walk away while waiting; desktop alerts help pull them back.

guard.reason: Adds an opt-in desktop notification setting on home_intro, which is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses very high mean finish duration (5815s) by bringing users back via desktop alerts.

candidates.title: Split View Path Choice Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a side-by-side split comparison card layout for ready-made vs custom paths.
candidates.why: Path selection drops off by 23.8% (76.2% conversion). A clear split comparison helps users make faster, confident decisions.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Digital Pet Path
choose_path.body: Choose a instantly available preset companion or generate a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path layout while retaining both adopt and custom pet options.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns consistently fall far short of optimistic predictions and show minimal impact.

candidates.title: Cloud Account Pet Preservation Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly highlight cloud account link protection against pet resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud
sign_in.body: Link your account now to ensure your pet progress and customized assets are securely backed up.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to emphasize account save without requesting unnecessary data.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and low cost, but copy changes historically showed no lift.

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Pet Trait Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a new screen highlighting selected pet personality traits before finalizing adoption details.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion). Building emotional connection before final confirmation improves conversion.

new_trait_showcase.headline: Meet Your Companion's Personality
new_trait_showcase.body: Preview unique habits, sounds, and interactive traits of your companion.

guard.reason: Inserts a new pre-adoption trait showcase screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens introduces extra friction and historically shows negative lift (-2.6%).

candidates.title: First Launch Desktop Mascot Welcome Flow
candidates.change: Adds an inline mascot visual guide on the home intro screen showing how to summon and minimize the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support had 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop and 3 emails about confusion on how to control or hide pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click on your desktop companion anytime to open interaction controls or hide to system tray.

guard.reason: Adds desktop mascot visual guide to home_intro, which is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 6 support emails on confusion; new flows had moderate past adoption lift (+5.9%).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Completion Progress Bar
candidates.change: Adds a progress bar component and completion milestone badge to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and median duration of 89s.

guard.reason: Adds a progress indicator to the adoption certificate screen without removing required elements.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (39.1% loss) using progress cues to encourage completion.

candidates.title: Story Intro Reordering Sequence Flow
candidates.change: Reorders onboarding to show the choice of pet path first, followed by the background story introduction screen.
candidates.why: Story screen before path choice adds early friction (8s median / 514s mean at path choice step). Prompting action first increases momentum.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.change: Changes waiting screen layout to a clean compact card format displaying estimated wait time remaining.
candidates.why: Median wait time during home step is 201 seconds, causing user anxiety and abandonment.

lessons_next: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding predictions (+1.0%).
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy), reordering steps (reorder), or adding status indicators/animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for copy changes, step reordering, hints, and new screens/flows were consistently too high, while predictions for path choice redesign were too low.
